''See also: [[Tharlos, the Formless Legion Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Tharlos, also known as the Formless [[Legion]], is a [[Great Elder]] characterized by an obsession with constant and endless change. While some interpret his nature as wanting to destroy the world, others suggest that total [[destruction]] might simply be a byproduct of his primary drive for transformation. He is a chaotic entity whose presence can manifest as shifting, unstable figures that constantly alter their appearance. His influence is known to provoke unpredictability and a desire for metamorphosis in those around him. Tharlos's power is manifested through his [[Elderspawn]], which are shapeshifting creatures that lack a permanent form, appearing as melting combinations of various animals and objects. Additionally, an ancient artifact known as the [[Spear of Tharlos]] exists; it was fashioned during the Elder Days from a bone belonging to the entity itself. This six-foot weapon, featuring a [[spade]]-like blade, possesses its own will and can contort, shrink, or change shape. It exerts a powerful influence on its wielder, attempting to drive them toward change and reacting with sentient-like movements.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Tharlos is an unknown entity characterized as a squirming, shifting figure. This being possesses bones and blinks into a different form every single second.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Driven by a pursuit of change, Tharlos desires a world defined by constant and endless transformation. This entity seeks to burn everything to the ground, potentially destroying the world as an incidental byproduct of these actions.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Influence on Bliss}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Tharlos plays a role in influencing the unpredictability found within Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8" /> The entity experiences excitement when the Elder barrier causes a building to undergo transformation.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8" /> It is noted that [[Kelarac]] is a separate individual from Tharlos.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 12</ref> Ultimately, Tharlos is driven by the pursuit of change.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c24">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 24</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Tharlos, the Formless Legion{{!}}Tharlos influences Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss's unpredictability.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Tharlos, the Formless Legion{{!}}Tharlos is excited by the transformation of the building caused by the Elder barrier.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Kelarac]] is not Tharlos, the Formless Legion{{!}}Tharlos.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Tharlos, the Formless Legion{{!}}Tharlos pursues change.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c24" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The region of [[Erin]] formerly served as the border between Tharlos and [[Othaghor]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c1">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 1</ref> [[Ach'magut]] has explicitly clarified that he is not Tharlos.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 9</ref>}}
